title: Agent installation and canonical Skill source
objective: Install one Git-tracked canonical Project Skill across selected Agents/scopes with verified native discovery, symlink, or manifest-managed copy fallback.
acceptance_criteria: A single canonical Project Skill is maintained.
Selected Agents can use independent Global/Project/Both scopes.
Symlinks are preferred where verified; fallback copies record source version and per-file hashes.
Unselected Agents and unrelated configuration remain unchanged.
undo_classification: Use install manifests and verified ownership; retain modified/unowned files.
approval_requirements: Explicit user approval before any real installation mutation.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries; preserve staging/backups after failure.
